articles.headline: Andy Burnham joins critics of FIFA's World Cup private investment plan
articles.description: Prime Minister Andy Burnham has said "football does not belong to investors" as he joined the criticism of FIFA's plan to set up a new private company to run the World Cup and other competitions.

articles.headline: UEFA blasts FIFA proposal to allow for $10B in World Cup private investment
articles.description: UEFA has rejected a FIFA plan to sell stakes in the World Cup to private investors as a "line that football's governing institutions should never cross" and that the World Cup is "not FIFA's to sell."

articles.headline: What advanced stats say about every USMNT World Cup game since 1990
articles.description: The U.S. men's latest World Cup exit was the latest in a long string of disappointments ... or was it? Let's look at the numbers behind all their tournament appearances since 1990 to get the real story.
